text.text: TEAM FUSION    Chris Paton · Nathan Ewer · Amber Wu · Eva Klemencic · Sasha Cheparukhin
Helping scientists choose which chimeric-RNA junction to test next.
A gene-pair score does not identify a testable junction. Evidence is scattered across reads, probes and papers.
Codex chooses evidence checks, reviews the results, and proposes a next step. A scientist can revise or defer it.
Codex executed 12 bounded tool calls across three cases on Brev. Every recorded output replays exactly.
